question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales,
            (DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) - DATE('2017-01-01')) as day_num
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE p.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
        GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
    )
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        slope,
        intercept,
        slope * 701 + intercept as pred_3,
        slope * 702 + intercept as pred_4,
        slope * 703 + intercept as pred_5,
        slope * 704 + intercept as pred_6,
        slope * 705 + intercept as pred_7,
        slope * 706 + intercept as pred_8,
        slope * 707 + intercept as pred_9,
        slope * 708 + intercept as pred_10
    FROM regression_params
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        (pred_3 + pred_4 + pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7) / 5.0 as ma_5,
        (pred_4 + pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8) / 5.0 as ma_6,
        (pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8 + pred_9) / 5.0 as ma_7,
        (pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8 + pred_9 + pred_10) / 5.0 as ma_8
    FROM predictions
)
SELECT ma_5, ma_6, ma_7, ma_8, (ma_5 + ma_6 + ma_7 + ma_8) as total_sum
FROM moving_averages

WITH regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales,
            (DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) - DATE('2017-01-01')) as day_num
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE p.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
          AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
        GROUP BY DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
    )
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        slope,
        intercept,
        slope * 701 + intercept as pred_3,
        slope * 702 + intercept as pred_4,
        slope * 703 + intercept as pred_5,
        slope * 704 + intercept as pred_6,
        slope * 705 + intercept as pred_7,
        slope * 706 + intercept as pred_8,
        slope * 707 + intercept as pred_9,
        slope * 708 + intercept as pred_10
    FROM regression_params
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        (pred_3 + pred_4 + pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7) / 5.0 as ma_5,
        (pred_4 + pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8) / 5.0 as ma_6,
        (pred_5 + pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8 + pred_9) / 5.0 as ma_7,
        (pred_6 + pred_7 + pred_8 + pred_9 + pred_10) / 5.0 as ma_8
    FROM predictions
)
SELECT ma_5, ma_6, ma_7, ma_8, (ma_5 + ma_6 + ma_7 + ma_8) as total_sum
FROM moving_averages
